citations.case_name: Tessaly Grain Cooperative v. Brennock Rail Corp.
citations.quote: A shipper must file its claim within nine months of delivery. The period runs from the date the goods were delivered, not the date the loss was discovered.

citations.case_name: Tessaly Grain Cooperative v. Brennock Rail Corp.
citations.quote: The period runs from the date the goods were delivered, not the date the loss was discovered. A claim filed late is barred even where the carrier suffered no prejudice.

citations.case_name: Tessaly Grain Cooperative v. Brennock Rail Corp.
citations.quote: The carrier's notice told shippers that a claim must be filed in writing at the carrier's principal office and that any other filing shall be void.
